tools.name: search
tools.description: Hybrid (keyword + semantic) search over every page of dadaville.ch. Returns passages with their page url. Use fetch with a result id for the full page.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full Markdown text of a dadaville.ch page. id is a url returned by search (or any dadaville.ch url or path).

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Every page of dadaville.ch with its url, section and summary.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Markdown of a page by path, e.g. /attivita, /sedi/villa-bonetti, /101/angelo-duro or / for the home.

tools.name: list_persone
tools.description: The Personaggi of the Piattaforma dei 101, optionally filtered by tag (Personaggio or Singolo), sector or city.

tools.name: get_persona
tools.description: Profile of a Personaggio of the Piattaforma dei 101 by slug (nome-cognome) or name.

tools.name: list_sedi
tools.description: The historic residences documented as Sedi Dadaville.

tools.name: get_sede
tools.description: History, sections and sources of a Sede Dadaville by slug or name.

tools.name: define
tools.description: Definition from the Glossario Dadaville (e.g. Settimane Dada21, Sede Dadaville, Dada21 DAO). Accent and case insensitive.

tools.name: get_ecosistema
tools.description: Nodes and connections of the Ecosistema Dadaville graph shown on /holding-group.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
